title: Hoover Gave Away Free Flights. It Cost Them Millions.
description:
Hoover said: buy a vacuum, fly free.

In 1992, Hoover's British branch offered two free return flights to anyone who spent £100 on its products, and later added flights to the US. The cheapest qualifying vacuum cost about £120, but the tickets were worth far more. Hoover expected around 50,000 claims; hundreds of thousands came, and the bill reached tens of millions of pounds. Three top managers lost their jobs, and in 1995 Maytag sold Hoover's European business to Candy.

⚠️ Dramatised: characters and scenes are illustrations. The facts are real. This is history, not investment advice.
